annotation.title_clean: Enabling a national cyber-physical infrastructure (CPI) to catalyse innovation
annotation.title_en: Enabling a national cyber-physical infrastructure (CPI) to catalyse innovation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy
annotation.summary_en: This GOV.UK page covers a UK government consultation from March 2022, with the government response added in March 2023. The consultation asked for views on a national cyber-physical infrastructure: connected digital twins and smart robotic systems meant to drive innovation. The response sets out key enablers, a grant competition and more than £30m in funding for digital twins.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision of a decentralised, internet-like network of connected cyber-physical systems, including digital twins and smart robotic systems
Consultation ran 2 March to 11 May 2022 and received 61 responses
Grant competition to fund organisations that develop and host a cyber-physical infrastructure ecosystem
Over £30m of funding for digital twinning, plus Department for Transport investment in transport digital twins
Framed around net zero and responses to global health crises
